question.text: After Chen Lu sent the problem image, what specific question did he raise based on the image?

questions.original_answer: Ask Fang Qing if the hospital has any cases involving children with scoliosis.

supporting_evidence.content: Chen Lu: [Sent picture: 1.jpg] Fang Qing, I've been thinking about buying a new backpack for my son recently. He's starting elementary school, and I saw several brands at the mall promoting spine protection features, all at similar prices. I took a photo, but it's overwhelming to look at. Have you encountered any cases of scoliosis in children at your hospital? From a professional perspective, do you have any suggestions?
